description_en: Queries the tasks that are created to migrate the backup data of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server实例备份数据上云任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-migrate-tasks --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --start-time 2017-10-20T01:00Z --end-time 2017-10-25T01:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMigrateTasks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须大于开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

MigrateTask.description_en: The details of the migration task
MigrateTask.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务信息列表

items.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务信息详情

BackupMode.description_en:
The migration task type. Valid values:

FULL: The migration task migrates full backup files that can be used to restore the full data of the instance.
UPDF: The migration task migrates incremental or log backup files that can be used to restore the incremental data of the instance
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份数据上云任务类型，取值：
FULL：表示通过全量备份文件去执行还原操作。
UPDF：表示通过增量文件或者日志文件去还原增量部分的数据

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the migration task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务创建时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the migration task
Description.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务的描述信息

EndTime.description_en: The time when the migration task was completed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

IsDBReplaced.description_en: Indicates whether the imported data overwrites the existing data

Status.description_en:
The status of the migration task. Valid values:

NoStart: The task is not started.
Running:The task is in progress.
Success: The task is successful.
Failed: The task failed.
Waiting: The task is waiting for an incremental backup file to be imported
Status.description_zh:
备份数据上云任务的状态，取值：
NoStart：未开始
Running：运行中
Success：成功
Failed：失败
Waiting：等待（等待增量备份文件导入）

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalRecordCount.description_zh: 满足条件的总的记录数
